contents.text: What was the effect of the Ireland statutory tax rate difference on Microsoft's effective tax rate in fiscal year 2026?

The effect of the Ireland statutory tax rate difference on Microsoft's effective tax rate in fiscal year 2026 was a decrease of $4,301 million, or 2.6% (Source: MSFT-10K-2026.html, PART II > Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data > Income Taxes).
